items.title_en: Exam questions tested by LLMs? National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine certification center: no cooperation with any LLM company, no evaluation conducted
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，11 月 21 日晚，国家中医药管理局中医师资格认证中心通过官方公众号发布声明称，该中心从未公开历年真题，未与任何大模型企业合作，亦未开展测评。 声明称，近期部分人工智能大模型产品及其运营、推广主体宣称其 大模型经过了中医类别医师资格考试试题测试 等事宜。 声明称，中心从未以任何形式向社会公开、发布或出售中医类别医师资格考试历年试题（含真题、原题）、参考答案及相关考试资料，亦未授权任何单位或个人公开、发布、销售。市场上以“历年真题”“官方真题”“内部题库”“原题还原”等名义提供、销售或 用于训练、测评人工智能大模型的内容 ，均非中心提供。 声明还称， 中心从未与任何人工智能大模型企业、平台或相关机构建立合作关系 ；未授权任何主体使用中心名称、简称、标识、考试数据及考试资料用于大模型训练、产品宣传或者商业推广；中心未对任何大模型产品开展过测评、认证、认可或者推荐。 声明表示，任何单位或者个人应立即停止不当宣传，删除、下架相关信息与内容，中心保留依法追究其法律责任的一切权利。 IT之家从公开资料获悉，国家中医药管理局中医师资格认证中心，2000 年 12 月 19 日，经中华人民共和国中央编制委员会办公室批准，成立了国家中医药管理局中医师资格认证中心。2007 年经批准增加组织实施中医药行业特有工种职业技能鉴定工作职能，并加挂国家中医药管理局职业技能鉴定指导中心牌子。2022 年中编办批准中心机构职能和编制调整。 该中心承担中医药行业相关考试和人才评价，以及有关考试质量评估、科学研究与交流、信息化建设等工作，中医药行业职业技能鉴定的有关指导工作。
items.summary_en: On the evening of Nov 21, the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine TCM Physician Qualification Certification Center said in a statement via its official WeChat account that it has never publicly released past exam questions, has not cooperated with any large-model company, and has not conducted evaluations. The statement said the center has never in any form publicized, released or sold past TCM physician qualification exam questions (including real questions and original questions), reference answers or related exam materials, nor authorized any unit or individual to publicize, release or sell them; content offered or sold on the market under names such as “past exam questions,” “official exam questions,” “internal question bank” or “original question restoration,” or used for training or evaluating AI large models, is not provided by the center. It also said the center has never established cooperative relations with any AI large-model company, platform or related institution; has not authorized any entity to use its name, abbreviation, logo, exam data or exam materials for large-model training, product promotion or commercial promotion; and has not evaluated, certified, recognized or recommended any large-model product. The center said any unit or individual should immediately stop improper promotion and delete or take down related information and content, and it reserves all rights to pursue legal liability. Public information shows the center was established on Dec 19, 2000 with approval from the Central Institutional Organization Commission Office; in 2007 it added the function of organizing vocational skill appraisal for special TCM industry jobs; in 2022 its functions and staffing were adjusted; it undertakes TCM industry exams and talent evaluation, exam quality assessment, scientific research and exchange, informatization, and guidance for vocational skill appraisal.
items.why_zh: 推测：声明划清官方考试资料与大模型训练、测评的界限，可能影响相关数据合规与宣传表述。
items.why_en: Speculative: the statement draws a line between official exam materials and LLM training/evaluation, potentially affecting data compliance and marketing claims.

items.title_zh: 加密聊天应用 Signal 默认屏蔽截图，防止 AI 智能体读取用户消息
items.title_en: Encrypted chat app Signal blocks screenshots by default to prevent AI agents from reading user messages
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，开源端到端加密聊天应用 Signal 近日推出 iOS / Android 版更新，默认关闭应用程序内截图功能，以阻止 Siri AI 和 Gemini 等 AI 智能体读取用户私人消息。 Signal 总裁 Meredith Whittaker 表示，系统级 AI 智能体的影响力正不断扩大，这对 Signal 长期建立的隐私机制构成威胁，因为这些智能体可能在用户毫不知情的情况下访问私人对话。 在 Signal 8.37（IT之家注：iOS 27 系统）中， 应用默认启用了“阻止 Siri AI”设置 ，用户无法在 Signal 内截图或录屏。用户可选择关闭该功能 10 分钟，或是直接永久禁用。 来到安卓这边，Signal 8.35.1 或更高版本检测到 AI 助手试图截图读取消息时，会自动启用“屏幕安全”策略阻止截屏。不过官方表示，由于不同安卓设备的实现方式存在差异，这项检测功能并不能在所有设备上稳定运行。 此外 Signal 表示，由于缺少必要开发工具，macOS 版 Signal 无法实现类似的防止截图功能。官方建议用户在系统设置中，将 Signal 放入“Siri 排除列表”中。
items.summary_en: The open-source end-to-end encrypted chat app Signal recently released iOS/Android updates that disable in-app screenshots by default, to stop AI agents such as Siri AI and Gemini from reading users' private messages. Signal President Meredith Whittaker said system-level AI agents are growing in influence and threaten Signal's long-standing privacy mechanisms, because such agents may access private conversations without users' knowledge. In Signal 8.37 (iOS 27), the app enables a “Block Siri AI” setting by default, so users cannot take screenshots or record the screen inside Signal; users can disable it for 10 minutes or permanently. On Android, Signal 8.35.1 or later automatically enables a “screen security” policy to block screenshots when it detects an AI assistant trying to capture messages to read them. However, the company said that because Android device implementations differ, this detection does not work reliably on all devices. Signal also said the macOS version cannot implement similar screenshot prevention due to a lack of necessary development tools, and recommends that users add Signal to the “Siri exclusion list” in system settings.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映端侧 AI 智能体权限扩张与加密通信隐私保护之间的冲突。
items.why_en: Speculative: this reflects tension between expanding on-device AI agent permissions and privacy protection in encrypted communications.

items.title_zh: 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格：随着 AI 需要“一万倍的效率飞跃”，渐进式芯片性能提升无法满足
items.title_en: Former Intel CEO Gelsinger: AI needs a "10,000x efficiency leap," incremental chip gains won't suffice
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据 Wccftech 报道，前英特尔首席执行官帕特 · 基辛格（Pat Gelsinger）表示，随着人工智能需要“ 10,000 倍的效率飞跃 ”，渐进式的芯片增益将无法满足需求，他同时否认了摩尔定律已走向终结。 在 2026 年 COSM 科技峰会上，帕特 · 基辛格出席了一场题为“现实检验：超越芯片（Reality Check: Beyond Chips）”的炉边谈话。 基辛格在谈话中反驳了半导体微缩已触及物理极限的观点， 他认为 AI 需要的不是常规的代际升级，而是计算效率实现激进的 10,000 倍跃升 。他还指出，摩尔定律（Moore’s Law）能否重焕生机，取决于五大核心工程领域（IT之家注：光学、供电、散热、材料和封装）的根本性突破。 峰会结束后，帕特 · 基辛格在 X 上写道：“ 摩尔定律已死？我说现在是唤醒它的时候了 ！”尽管一些行业观察人士可能会认为传统的摩尔定律微缩已经结束，但基辛格坚持认为半导体工程正在进入一个多学科创新的新时代，他表示：“在半导体行业工作 40 多年后，我相信我们最伟大的创新仍在前方！” 自 2025 年 3 月以普通合伙人身份加入风险投资机构 Playground Global 以来，基辛格一直在积极支持针对这些硬件瓶颈的初创企业，其中包括获得美国政府支持的光刻初创企业 xLight（该公司目标突破阿斯麦 ASML 的 13.5 纳米极紫外 EUV 波长壁垒），以及核能产能公司 Alva Energy。 除了光刻与发电领域，基辛格的技术路线图还瞄准了光互连与硅光子技术，旨在用光信号替代传统的铜线来传输数据。 相关阅读： 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格称 HBM 是“糟糕的内存” 》 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格押注新 AI 内存：Z2RAM 拟绕开 EUV 光刻，4 年内送样 》
items.summary_en: According to Wccftech, former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said that with AI requiring a "10,000x efficiency leap," incremental chip gains will not be enough, while rejecting the idea that Moore's Law is over. At the 2026 COSM technology summit, Gelsinger took part in a fireside chat titled "Reality Check: Beyond Chips." He pushed back on the view that semiconductor scaling has hit physical limits, arguing that AI needs not routine generational upgrades but a radical 10,000x jump in computing efficiency. He also said whether Moore's Law can be revived depends on fundamental breakthroughs in five core engineering areas: optics, power delivery, thermal management, materials and packaging. After the summit, Gelsinger wrote on X: "Moore's Law is dead? I say it's time to wake it up!" While some industry observers may believe traditional Moore's Law scaling has ended, Gelsinger insists semiconductor engineering is entering a new era of multidisciplinary innovation, saying: "After more than 40 years in the semiconductor industry, I believe our greatest innovations are still ahead of us!" Since joining venture firm Playground Global as a general partner in March 2025, Gelsinger has actively backed startups targeting these hardware bottlenecks, including US-government-backed lithography startup xLight, which aims to break ASML's 13.5-nanometer extreme ultraviolet (EUV) wavelength barrier, and nuclear capacity company Alva Energy. Beyond lithography and power generation, Gelsinger's roadmap also targets optical interconnect and silicon photonics, aiming to replace traditional copper wiring with optical signals for data transmission.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映前沿AI算力瓶颈正把讨论从单纯制程微缩推向材料、封装、供电与光互连等多学科工程，但属个人判断而非行业共识。
items.why_en: Speculative: this reflects how frontier AI compute bottlenecks are pushing debate beyond pure process scaling toward multidisciplinary engineering in materials, packaging, power and optical interconnect, but it is one person's view rather than an industry consensus.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 数学家 AI 攻克黎曼猜想？Lean 社区通过核验，数十人报告代码库编译正确
items.title_en: Anthropic Mathematician's AI Said to Crack Riemann Hypothesis? Lean Community Passes Verification; Dozens Report Codebase Compiles Correctly
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，11 月 21 日，Lean 与 Mathlib 社区发布联合声明，称莱文特・阿尔波格（Levent Alpöge）以 Lean 库形式给出的黎曼猜想证明已经通过核验， 该证明的代码约 1700 万行 。（IT 之家注：Lean 是交互式定理证明器，可逐行机械核验数学推理是否符合逻辑公理。） 声明由 Lean 与 Mathlib 社区联合发布，并获 Lean FRO 与 Mathlib Initiative 背书。声明称，阿尔波格的库仅直接依赖 Mathlib；过去一天内，Lean 与 Mathlib 社区已参与验证。 声明列出四项核验标准，并称这几项标准均已满足： 陈述正确： 证明所用的陈述来自 Mathlib 的 RiemannHypothesis，已由 Lean 与数论专家审核； 代码可编译： 数十人报告编译通过，并复现出相同的原始证明导出文件； 证明对应正确陈述： 社区新增一个仅导入 Mathlib 的文件以隔离该陈述，再用 comparator 和 con-leche --compare 两套独立工具比对，确认库中证明的定理与 Mathlib 的陈述完全一致； 证明有效： 原始导出文件经多个证明检查器检验，包括 Lean 官方内核、con-leche、con-ron，以及第三方以不同编程语言实现的检查器。 声明特别提到，con-leche 与 con-ron 附带相对集合论的形式化证明，因此可以保证它们不会接受错误证明，这也回应了“Lean 逻辑本身可能存在漏洞”的担忧。上述检查在惰性导出文件上运行，不受源码中潜在恶意代码影响。 声明最后称，感谢为验证提供资源的社区成员，并期待数学界后续工作解释该证明中的新思路。 IT之家注： 黎曼猜想由德国数学家伯恩哈德 · 黎曼于 1859 年提出 ，认为看似随机分布在数轴上的质数，实际上遵循着复杂而有意义的规律。此后，黎曼猜想成为整个数论研究领域的重要指引，也是数学界最著名的未解难题。 IT之家附声明原文及译文： Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis Joint statement by the Lean and Mathlib communities, endorsed by the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative. On November 20, 2026, Levent Alpöge released a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis as a Lean library comprising 17 million lines of code. We have full confidence that Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct, and we congratulate him on this achievement. Our rationale is outlined below. The codebase depends directly only on Mathlib. Over the past day, the Lean and Mathlib communities have rallied to verify the proof's correctness. We hereby certify that both the statement and the proof of the Riemann Hypothesis are correct. The four criteria in https://xenaproject.wordpress.com/2026/11/12/and-the-proof-is-checked-in-lean/ are all satisfied. The statement of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct. items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 22 that on Nov 21 the Lean and Mathlib communities issued a joint statement saying Levent Alpöge's Lean-library proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, comprising about 17 million lines of code, had passed verification; the statement was issued by the Lean and Mathlib communities and endorsed by the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative. The statement lists four verification criteria and says all were met: the statement is correct—it comes from Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis and was reviewed by Lean and number-theory experts; the code compiles—dozens reported successful compilation and reproduced the same original proof export file; the proof corresponds to the correct statement—the community added a file importing only Mathlib to isolate the statement and used two independent tools, comparator and con-leche --compare, to confirm the theorem proved in the library exactly matches Mathlib's statement; the proof is valid—the original export file was checked by multiple proof checkers, including the official Lean kernel, con-leche, con-ron, and third-party checkers implemented in different programming languages. The statement says con-leche and con-ron come with formal proofs relative to set theory, so they can be guaranteed not to accept incorrect proofs; the checks were run on lazy export files and are not affected by potentially malicious code in the source. The statement thanks community members who provided resources for verification and looks forward to follow-up work by the mathematics community explaining the new ideas in the proof. The attached original statement says Alpöge released the proof on Nov 20, 2026. IT Home notes that the Riemann Hypothesis was proposed by Bernhard Riemann in 1859 and is an important guide in number theory and one of mathematics' most famous unsolved problems.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息， 腾讯 Chatterfly 输入法安卓版现已开启内测 ，iOS 版目前状态为“即将发布”。 据介绍，Chatterfly 输入法除了将语音变成文字外，还能理解上下文，识别不同的意图和场景，还能听懂用户的需求，帮用户执行任务。 IT之家附该输入法主要特性如下： 语音输入，说完即成稿：不用组织语言，Chatterfly 能自动识别语境，帮你理成清楚、得体的话； 说完自动翻译：翻译模式支持一键唤起，将语音直接翻译为指定语言，让交流如母语般自然； 全场景 AI 打字，打字更顺心：超强意图理解能力，超全词库品类，持续学习你的打字习惯，输入更省心； 表达 Skill，场景化深度润色：工作汇报、会议纪要、AI 提示词、营销文案… 启用 Skill，AI 自动识别场景，深度润色加工； AI 指令，快速执行任务：文本创作、即时翻译、信息提炼…… 只需按下快捷键，说话就能下达指令，让 Chatterfly 直接输出结果。 参考： https://chatterfly.tencent.com/
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 22 that the Android version of Tencent's Chatterfly keyboard has opened beta testing, while the iOS version is listed as coming soon. According to the description, besides turning speech into text, the keyboard can understand context, identify different intents and scenarios, and help users execute tasks. Main features include: voice input that turns speech into a draft, automatically recognizing context and organizing it into clear, appropriate wording; automatic translation after speaking, with a translation mode invoked by one click to translate speech directly into a specified language; all-scenario AI typing with intent understanding and a broad vocabulary, continuously learning the user's typing habits; Expression Skills for deep, scenario-based polishing in work reports, meeting minutes, AI prompts, marketing copy and other scenarios; and AI commands that let users press a shortcut and speak to issue tasks such as text creation, instant translation and information extraction, with Chatterfly directly outputting the result. Reference: chatterfly.tencent.com.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息， 腾讯 Chatterfly 输入法安卓版现已开启内测 ，iOS 版目前状态为“即将发布”。 据介绍，Chatterfly 输入法除了将语音变成文字外，还能理解上下文，识别不同的意图和场景，还能听懂用户的需求，帮用户执行任务。 IT之家附该输入法主要特性如下： 语音输入，说完即成稿：不用组织语言，Chatterfly 能自动识别语境，帮你理成清楚、得体的话； 说完自动翻译：翻译模式支持一键唤起，将语音直接翻译为指定语言，让交流如母语般自然； 全场景 AI 打字，打字更顺心：超强意图理解能力，超全词库品类，持续学习你的打字习惯，输入更省心； 表达 Skill，场景化深度润色：工作汇报、会议纪要、AI 提示词、营销文案… 启用 Skill，AI 自动识别场景，深度润色加工； AI 指令，快速执行任务：文本创作、即时翻译、信息提炼…… 只需按下快捷键，说话就能下达指令，让 Chatterfly 直接输出结果。 参考： https://chatterfly.tencent.com/

items.title_zh: 美参议员痛批苹果、谷歌：放任 AI 脱衣应用“野蛮生长”
items.title_en: US senators criticize Apple and Google for allowing AI "nudify" apps
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据英国《卫报》报道，美国参议员罗恩 · 怀登、埃德 · 马基和本 · 卢汉指出，苹果和谷歌未能有效识别或下架用于生成未经当事人同意的裸照或色情图像的应用。 三人还指出，Meta 仍在从这些所谓的 AI 脱衣应用广告中获利。 当地时间 18 日，三人向苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的 CEO 致函，指出各公司现有的防护措施 不足以阻止 AI 脱衣应用出现在各自的应用商店或平台上 。 研究发现，苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的政策均禁止此类应用，它们却仍然出现在苹果和谷歌应用商店中，或通过 Meta 平台上的广告推广。研究还发现，儿童依然能够轻易接触到这些应用。 来自俄勒冈州的参议员怀登指出，如果这些公司不加强打击那些专门为造成伤害而设计并推广的应用，国会就需要采取行动。“AI 大幅提升了制作和传播未经当事人同意的色情影像的能力，给女性和女孩造成了巨大伤害。大型科技公司没有增加应对这一挑战的投入，反而在削减负责保护用户免受伤害的团队。我希望弄清楚，为什么 Meta、苹果和谷歌会漏掉那些明显违反自身规则的行为。” 谷歌发言人卡尔 · 瑞安在声明中回应称：“Google Play 不允许含有色情内容或允许用户对他人图像进行 AI 脱衣处理的应用上架。我们一直主动采取措施，检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。” Meta 发言人安迪 · 斯通在声明中回应称：“我们禁止传播儿童性虐待材料（CSAM），也禁止推广 AI 脱衣应用，并积极采取措施，防止此类内容出现在我们的平台上。…… 我们已经采取多项措施打击这些行为，包括封禁、对其他广告商采取法律行动、打击协同行动网络，以及 删除 9200 万条色情广告 。我们也在积极探索进一步改进检测能力的方法。” 苹果发言人彼得 · 阿杰米安表示，TTP 的报告并未反映苹果现行的软件及安全功能。苹果新增的保护措施包括加强对青少年的保护，以及在“屏幕使用时间”中扩展家长控制功能，让家庭能够阻止儿童和青少年下载年龄分级超出其年龄范围的应用。 IT之家从报道中获悉，参议员们在信中指出，过去两年， 未经当事人同意而由 AI 生成的裸照数量有所增加 。这一趋势也在多项调查得到印证。联合国儿童基金会在 2026 年初发布的报告显示，11 个国家至少有 120 万名儿童报告称，自己曾遭遇未经本人同意的裸照侵害。 10 月，TTP 研究人员就他们在苹果 App Store 发现的 AI 脱衣应用联系苹果后，苹果对自身政策作出了进一步说明。谷歌此前向《卫报》表示，公司会主动检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。Meta 则推出了新的 AI 工具，专门用于识别和删除含有 CSAM 的广告。 参议员们在信中写道，这些发现表明，苹果和谷歌不仅没有下架助长私密影像侵害的应用，还可能从这些应用的分发过程中获利。
items.summary_en: According to The Guardian, US Senators Ron Wyden, Ed Markey and Ben Luján said Apple and Google have failed to effectively identify or remove apps used to generate non-consensual nude or sexual images, and that Meta is still profiting from ads for so-called AI nudify apps. On the 18th local time, the three sent letters to the CEOs of Apple, Google and Meta, saying the companies' existing safeguards are insufficient to keep AI nudify apps off their app stores or platforms. Research found that all three companies' policies prohibit such apps, yet they still appear in Apple's and Google's app stores or are promoted through ads on Meta's platforms, and that children can still easily access them. Senator Wyden of Oregon said that if the companies do not crack down harder on apps designed and promoted to cause harm, Congress will need to act, adding: "AI has dramatically increased the ability to create and spread non-consensual sexual imagery, causing enormous harm to women and girls. Instead of increasing investment to meet this challenge, Big Tech companies are cutting teams responsible for protecting users from harm. I want to understand why Meta, Apple and Google are missing conduct that clearly violates their own rules." Google spokesperson Karl Ryan said in a statement that "Google Play does not allow apps that contain sexual content or that allow users to AI-undress images of others. We take proactive steps to detect and remove apps with harmful content." Meta spokesperson Andy Stone said: "We prohibit the dissemination of child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and the promotion of AI nudify apps, and we take active measures to prevent such content on our platforms... We have taken multiple steps to combat this, including bans, legal action against other advertisers, action against coordinated networks, and the removal of 92 million sexual ads. We are also actively exploring ways to further improve our detection capabilities." Apple spokesperson Peter Ajemian said TTP's report does not reflect Apple's current software and safety features; Apple's added protections include stronger safeguards for minors and expanded parental controls in Screen Time so families can block children and teens from downloading apps rated above their age. The senators' letter said AI-generated non-consensual nude images have increased over the past two years, a trend corroborated by multiple investigations. A UNICEF report published in early 2026 found that at least 1.2 million children across 11 countries reported being victims of non-consensual nude imagery. In October, after TTP researchers contacted Apple about AI nudify apps they found in the App Store, Apple provided further clarification of its policies. Google previously told The Guardian it proactively detects and removes apps with harmful content, and Meta launched a new AI tool specifically to identify and remove ads containing CSAM. The senators wrote that these findings show Apple and Google have not only failed to remove apps that facilitate intimate-image abuse but may also profit from distributing them.

items.why_en: Speculative: this shows AI-generated non-consensual intimate imagery is becoming a focus of platform-governance and legislative pressure, but the letter's allegations and the companies' responses remain competing claims, with no independent verification provided in the summary.

items.title_zh: 代码显示三星正为 One UI 9.5 开发 AI 智能天气提醒功能：可根据用户作息与通勤时间推送通知
items.title_en: Code suggests Samsung is developing AI smart weather alerts for One UI 9.5, timed to users' routines and commutes
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，外媒 SammyGuru 在拆解三星最新 One UI 9.5 测试版时，发现三星正在为天气应用测试多项 AI 智能提醒功能，系统能够识别用户的起床时间和通勤行为，在用户起床、上班或下班回家时自动加载最新天气信息。 具体来看，相应功能依赖三星 Personal Data Intelligence（个人数据智能）系统，能够识别用户早晨何时起床、何时开始通勤，当系统检测到用户离开家或工作地点时，天气应用便会向用户自动弹出天气预报卡片。 在隐私方面，相应代码字符串显示 Personal Data Intelligence 会在用户设备本地分析位置数据，但用户的经纬度信息仍会分享给三星天气数据服务提供商 The Weather Channel，该服务商只会将位置数据用于提供天气信息，不会与第三方分享。 除了天气应用，三星还计划让 One UI 9.5 中的其他功能了解用户的日常通勤习惯。外媒 Android Authority 此前发现，三星为新版系统悄悄新增一项“三星驾驶报告（Driving Report）”功能，该功能能够在用户驾车出行前提前检查天气状况和睡眠评分，并在用户出发时间前约 1 小时推送相关提醒。 结合本次天气应用新增的通勤天气预测功能来看，三星似乎希望通过 One UI 9.5 更全面地学习用户的日常作息和出行规律，从而提供更加主动的个性化服务，预计这些功能将于明年年初 Galaxy S27 系列发布时在 One UI 9.5 正式版上线。
items.summary_en: Foreign outlet SammyGuru said that while examining Samsung's latest One UI 9.5 beta, it found Samsung is testing multiple AI smart reminder features for its weather app, with the system able to recognize users' wake-up times and commuting behavior and automatically load the latest weather information when users wake up, go to work or head home. The features rely on Samsung's Personal Data Intelligence system, which can identify when a user wakes up in the morning and when they start commuting; when the system detects the user leaving home or the workplace, the weather app automatically pops up a forecast card. On privacy, code strings indicate Personal Data Intelligence analyzes location data locally on the device, but the user's latitude and longitude are still shared with Samsung weather data provider The Weather Channel, which uses the location data only to provide weather information and does not share it with third parties. Beyond the weather app, Samsung also plans to let other One UI 9.5 features learn users' daily commuting habits. Android Authority previously found that Samsung quietly added a "Driving Report" feature to the new system, which can check weather conditions and sleep scores before a user drives and push a reminder about an hour before departure. Combined with the new commute-based weather prediction, Samsung appears to want One UI 9.5 to learn users' daily routines and travel patterns more comprehensively to offer more proactive personalized services; the features are expected to launch in the official One UI 9.5 with the Galaxy S27 series early next year.
items.why_zh: 推测：若落地，这类基于行为预测的主动提醒把个性化与隐私权衡推到前台，但当前仅为测试版代码线索，功能与上线时间未获官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculative: if shipped, such behavior-predicting proactive alerts would foreground the trade-off between personalization and privacy, but these are only beta code clues and neither the features nor the launch timing have been officially confirmed.

items.title_zh: “大空头”迈克尔 · 伯里谈 AI 股暴跌：我早就提醒过你们了
items.title_en: "Big Short" Michael Burry on the AI stock selloff: I warned you
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，“大空头”迈克尔 · 伯里在 X 平台发文称：“CoreWeave、Nebius、英伟达，还有半导体股，我都试着提醒过大家。我没让你们做空，但我提供的信息 足以让你们决定卖出股票 。” 当地时间 20 日开盘，英伟达股价下跌约 4%（最高跌幅达 14%），CoreWeave 和 Nebius 的跌幅均在 7% 左右。 据《商业内幕》报道，自 10 月 6 日触及盘中高点以来，英伟达、CoreWeave 和 Nebius 的股价分别下跌约 42%、55% 和 65%。本轮 AI 股回调始于 10 月 7 日，同期纽约证券交易所半导体指数累计下跌约 30%。 11 月 11 日，黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO 职务的前一天，伯里在 Substack 发文 呼吁股东卖出英伟达股票 。他预测，随着频频促成交易的黄仁勋离任，英伟达的 增长将放缓，利润率也将收窄 。 11 月 12 日，伯里又将警告范围扩大到 Nebius 和 CoreWeave 等英伟达合作伙伴。此类企业被称为“新型云服务商 / 新云服务商”， 主要通过建设数据中心，向客户出租英伟达芯片及其他 AI 基础设施的使用权 。 伯里指出，英伟达的市场影响力和慷慨扶持让这些企业受益匪浅，但这种局面似乎发生了根本变化。 早在 8 月 12 日，伯里就曾断言：“Nebius 就是繁荣行情见顶的写照。” Nebius 当天的收盘价为 259 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,733 元人民币） ，比 11 月 19 日的收盘价高出 62%。 再往前一周，伯里 8 月 6 日称自己 忍不住想做空 Nebius 和甲骨文 ，认为做空两家公司简直易如反掌。今年，他还做空过英伟达、CoreWeave 及半导体指数。 伯里一年前不再经营对冲基金，转而通过 Substack 分享个人投资观点。此后，他始终对 AI 股票的暴涨持公开怀疑态度。 作为一名逆向投资者，伯里曾是少数 成功预见 2008 年房地产泡沫破裂并从中获利 的人之一。他一直警告，AI 企业对芯片、数据中心等折旧迅速的资产投入过多资金。 伯里还批评 AI 企业采用激进的会计处理手法、开展循环融资交易，并背负着危险规模的债务和表外负债。 此次，伯里再次在 X 平台强调，他对英伟达及其合作伙伴和同行的担忧远不止黄仁勋涉嫌婚外情，以及民主党控制参众两院后可能出现的对 AI 行业不利的政治环境。“如果你还觉得这一切只是婚外情和政治问题，那就说明你 想得还不够深 。”
items.summary_en: "Big Short" investor Michael Burry wrote on X: "CoreWeave, Nebius, Nvidia, and semis — I tried to warn you. I didn't tell you to short, but the information I provided was enough for you to decide to sell." At the open on the 20th local time, Nvidia shares fell about 4% (with a maximum drop of 14%), while CoreWeave and Nebius each fell about 7%. According to Business Insider, since hitting intraday highs on Oct. 6, Nvidia, CoreWeave and Nebius shares are down about 42%, 55% and 65% respectively. The AI stock pullback began on Oct. 7, and the NYSE Semiconductor Index has fallen about 30% over the same period. On Nov. 11, the day before Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO, Burry published a Substack post urging shareholders to sell Nvidia, predicting that growth would slow and margins would narrow after Huang, who frequently brokered deals, departed. On Nov. 12, Burry widened his warning to Nvidia partners such as Nebius and CoreWeave. These companies, called "neoclouds," mainly build data centers and rent out access to Nvidia chips and other AI infrastructure. Burry said Nvidia's market influence and generous support benefited these firms, but that situation appears to have fundamentally changed. As early as Aug. 12, Burry declared: "Nebius is the picture of a boom topping out." Nebius closed that day at $259, 62% above its Nov. 19 close. A week earlier, on Aug. 6, Burry said he could hardly resist shorting Nebius and Oracle, calling shorting both companies easy. This year he also shorted Nvidia, CoreWeave and the semiconductor index. Burry stopped running a hedge fund a year ago and now shares his investment views on Substack; since then he has been openly skeptical of the AI stock surge. A contrarian investor, Burry was among the few who foresaw and profited from the 2008 housing bubble bust. He has warned that AI companies are investing too much in rapidly depreciating assets such as chips and data centers. Burry has also criticized AI companies for aggressive accounting, circular financing deals, and dangerous levels of debt and off-balance-sheet liabilities. On X this time, Burry stressed that his concerns about Nvidia, its partners and peers go far beyond Huang's alleged extramarital affair and the potentially unfavorable political environment for AI if Democrats control both chambers of Congress. items.title_zh: 韩国高考 AI 作弊事件发酵，教育部长引咎辞职
items.title_en: South Korea College Entrance Exam AI Cheating Scandal Escalates; Education Minister Resigns
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，据韩联社报道，当地时间 22 日，韩国教育部长官崔教振辞去职务，为韩国 2027 年度大学修学能力考试（韩国高考）期间防范高科技作弊措施不足引发混乱而承担责任。 近期，韩国发生多起利用人工智能工具作弊事件，引发民众广泛担忧。针对在考试前几天反复修改使用人工智能（AI）作弊的指导方针被不断修改，导致考生和教育界陷入“混乱”，这一批评进一步加剧。李在明 20 日在总统府青瓦台召开会议，呼吁对高考制度进行全面改革，应对人工智能快速发展下，各类新型作弊手段给考试公平带来的挑战。 IT之家注意到，韩国高考明确禁止考生携带任何电子设备进入考场，尤其是出现在近期多起作弊丑闻的人工智能（AI）眼镜。指南显示，禁带物品包括手机、平板电脑、AI 眼镜、智能手表、具备蓝牙通信功能的耳机等。 每个考点将安排一名工作人员专门检查 AI 眼镜 ，考生若佩戴 AI 眼镜，即使没有使用，也将被取消当年考试成绩和下一年度报考资格。 然而，在韩国教育部的大力管控下，仍然查处了 111 名违规携带智能设备的考生。据韩国教育部此前介绍，通过发送应急公益短信查出 54 起未上交手机 的案例；通过探测 WiFi 等方式查出 52 起携带智能设备案例。在考试过程中被发现利用智能终端的作弊案例 5 起，包括使用智能眼镜（1 起）、使用微型摄像头和无线耳机（1 起）、利用智能手机拍摄考卷（1 起），以及在洗手间使用智能手机（2 起）。 韩国教育部此前还表示，111 名作弊考生均属于与智能终端相关的违规人员，至于与智能终端无关的一般作弊行为，譬如违反考试时间规定等情况，未被计入本次统计。教育部正对作弊者携带的物品和作弊类型进行进一步分析， 并计划在 12 月 11 日高考成绩公布前完成相关处置工作 。
items.summary_en: According to Yonhap, on the 22nd local time, South Korean Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned to take responsibility for the confusion caused by insufficient measures against high-tech cheating during the 2027 College Scholastic Ability Test (South Korea's college entrance exam). Recently, multiple cases of cheating using AI tools have raised widespread concern; criticism intensified because guidelines on AI cheating were repeatedly revised in the days before the exam, throwing test-takers and the education sector into confusion. Lee Jae-myung convened a meeting at the presidential office in Cheong Wa Dae on the 20th and called for comprehensive reform of the exam system to address the challenge that new cheating methods pose to exam fairness amid rapid AI development. South Korea's exam explicitly bans electronic devices including phones, tablets, AI glasses, smartwatches and Bluetooth earphones; each test site assigns one staff member specifically to check AI glasses, and a test-taker wearing AI glasses, even without using them, will have that year's score cancelled and be barred from applying the following year. Despite these controls, 111 test-takers were caught violating rules on carrying smart devices: 54 cases of failing to hand in phones were found via emergency public-service text messages, 52 cases of carrying smart devices were found by detecting Wi-Fi and other means, and 5 cheating cases using smart terminals were found during the exam, including AI glasses (1), a miniature camera and wireless earphones (1), photographing the exam paper with a smartphone (1), and using a smartphone in the restroom (2). The ministry said all 111 were violations related to smart terminals and that general cheating unrelated to smart terminals, such as violating exam time rules, was not included; it is further analyzing the items carried and types of cheating and plans to complete handling before scores are announced on Dec 11.

items.why_en: It shows AI glasses and similar devices are putting real pressure on fairness in high-stakes exams; the resignation signals governance pressure, but the effect of new rules remains to be seen (speculative).

items.title_zh: 群联展示内置 NPU 与 64GB 内存的智能固态硬盘，可直接运行 AI 模型
items.title_en: Phison shows smart SSD with built-in NPU and 64GB memory that can run AI models directly
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，据科技媒体 Tom's Hardware 昨天报道，群联在 SC26 大会中展示两款企业级固态硬盘，专为 AI 场景设计。其中一款甚至带有 NPU 和 64GB 内存，可以直接运行 AI 模型。 IT之家从原报道获悉， 其中一款产品 SSD 内置 NPU（神经网络引擎） 、 64GB 内存 ，带宽达到 130GB/s，支持直接在硬盘上运行 PyTorch、vLLM、OpenVINO 和 llama.cpp 等 AI 框架及推理工具。 该产品的设计思路是将部分计算任务从服务器转移至 SSD，让设备直接处理存储的数据，仅向主机返回结果，无需完整传输数据集。 群联表示，该方案在特定工作负载下有望将数据传输量减少 10 至 100 倍，从而降低主机 CPU 的负载。 另一款产品采用全新的 Mixed Media 混合介质设计，将高耐久性的 pSLC 缓存与大容量 QLC 闪存整合在同一块 SSD 中，并通过一颗 16 通道主控进行管理。 该方案将部分 QLC 闪存切换至 SLC 工作模式，以牺牲部分存储容量为代价，提升写入性能和耐久性。两个存储区域分别分配独立命名空间，主机可以根据数据类型选择对应的存储区域，无需额外安装专用软件。 群联称这种方案能够减少独立缓存盘的依赖。在包含 24 块 SSD 的系统中，如果其中一块硬盘发生故障，缓存损失比例仅为 4%，而采用 4 块独立缓存盘的传统方案可能损失 25% 的缓存容量。
items.summary_en: According to tech media Tom's Hardware, Phison at the SC26 conference showed two enterprise SSDs designed for AI scenarios, one of which has a built-in NPU and 64GB of memory and can run AI models directly. The product has an integrated NPU (neural processing unit), 64GB of memory and 130GB/s bandwidth, and supports running AI frameworks and inference tools such as PyTorch, vLLM, OpenVINO and llama.cpp directly on the drive. Its design shifts some computing tasks from the server to the SSD, letting the device process stored data directly and return only results to the host without transferring the full dataset. Phison said the approach could reduce data transfer by 10 to 100 times under certain workloads, lowering host CPU load. Another product uses a new Mixed Media design that combines high-endurance pSLC cache with large-capacity QLC flash in a single SSD managed by a 16-channel controller. The approach switches part of the QLC flash to SLC mode, sacrificing some storage capacity to improve write performance and endurance. The two storage areas are assigned independent namespaces, and the host can choose the corresponding area based on data type without installing special software. Phison said this reduces reliance on separate cache drives; in a system with 24 SSDs, if one drive fails, cache loss is only 4%, while a traditional scheme with four separate cache drives could lose 25% of cache capacity.
items.why_zh: 推测：把推理能力下沉到存储设备，可能改变AI服务器的数据搬运方式和能效瓶颈。
items.why_en: Speculative: moving inference capability down to storage devices could change data movement and energy-efficiency bottlenecks in AI servers.

items.title_en: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
items.summary_zh: 这是“AI在现实生活”系列第三集、也是最后一集，主持人与The Verge资深AI记者Hayden Field讨论Anthropic的IPO。文中称，Claude背后的AI实验室上周四在纳斯达克上市；数字巨大，但对本次对话并不那么重要，只说明Anthropic已成为全球市值最高的公司之一。真正的问题在于接下来会发生什么，以及Anthropic能否在成为需对股东负责的上市公司的同时，继续兼顾并投资AI安全；此外它还要持续增长收入，以支付不断上升的算力账单——文中称未来几年合计约9000亿美元。Hayden与主持人试图分析，在Anthropic应对公开市场压力的过程中，这可能如何演变。节目还谈到该公司独特的公司治理结构（在“Jensen Huang”事件持续发酵的背景下尤显相关）、为何OpenAI似乎乐见Anthropic先上市，以及Anthropic面向大客户的整体卖点为何归结为同一套安全品牌——而这套品牌如今与其盈利导向的业务部分存在冲突。节目最后请听众订阅YouTube上的Decoder。
items.summary_en: Today, I’m talking with Hayden Field, The Verge ’s senior AI reporter, about the Anthropic IPO for the third and final episode in our series about AI in real life. The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but not really that important for this conversation, except to say that Anthropic has become one of the most valuable companies on the planet. The real story is what happens now — and whether Anthropic can continue to thread the needle of caring about and investing in AI safety while also being a public company beholden to shareholders. Oh, and it also continuously growing the amount of money it makes so it can keep paying its ever-increasing compute bills, which total roughly $900 billion over the coming years. All of these ideas sit in a fascinating tension with one another, and so Hayden and I really tried to break down how we think this might play out as Anthropic navigates the pressures of the public markets. You’ll hear us talk about the company’s unique corporate governance structure , something that is especially relevant in the wake of the ongoing Jensen Huang saga. We also get into why OpenAI seems happy to have let Anthropic go public first , and why Anthropic’s whole pitch to big customers boils down to the same safety branding that now sits in conflict with the profit-oriented part of its business. Before we get going, do me a favor and subscribe to Decoder on YouTube, where we put out new episodes every Monday and Thursday. items.title_en: South Korea's President Lee Jae-myung: speed is crucial in the AI race
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 21 日，韩国总统李在明前往韩国东南部城市蔚山，视察当地一座在建数据中心，并敦促韩国加快在全球 AI 竞赛中的步伐。“ 全世界都在竞相角逐，速度至关重要 。” 数据中心是芯片需求的重要来源。李在明希望，SK 建设的蔚山项目能够取得成功，进而吸引全球 AI 企业加大投资。 蔚山数据中心由 SK 集团与亚马逊云科技共同开发。韩国科学技术信息通信部去年公布的估算显示，项目到 2029 年的总投资额预计为 7 万亿韩元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 351.26 亿元人民币） ，计划于 2027 年下半年投入运营。 SK 集团会长崔泰源 9 月介绍，在建数据中心首期容量 预计到 2029 年达到 103MW ，未来还计划在此基础上 扩容近 900MW 。随着项目推进，SK 也计划与全球科技公司建立更多合作。 李在明指出，AI 投资此前主要集中在首尔一带，蔚山项目则说明其他地区同样具备增长空间。得知现场约有 900 人参与施工后，他还提到，高端设施建设面临建筑工人短缺，各部委需要考虑如何培养建设数据中心和 AI 基础设施所需的工人。
items.summary_en: According to Reuters, on the 21st local time, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung visited a data center under construction in the southeastern city of Ulsan and urged South Korea to speed up in the global AI race. "The whole world is competing, and speed is crucial," he said. Data centers are a major source of chip demand. Lee hopes the SK-built Ulsan project will succeed and attract more investment from global AI companies. The Ulsan data center is being developed by SK Group and Amazon Web Services. Estimates published last year by South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT put total investment in the project through 2029 at 7 trillion won, with operations planned to begin in the second half of 2027. SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won said in September that the first phase of the data center is expected to reach 103MW by 2029, with plans to add nearly 900MW on top of that. As the project advances, SK also plans more partnerships with global tech companies. Lee noted that AI investment had previously been concentrated around Seoul, and the Ulsan project shows other regions also have room to grow. After learning that about 900 people were working on the site, he also said high-end facility construction faces a shortage of construction workers and that ministries need to consider how to train the workers needed to build data centers and AI infrastructure.

items.summary_en: According to Business Insider, Jamal, 43, a former director of product management for AI application software at Nvidia who worked with Jensen Huang for three and a half years, described his close-up observations of Huang and what it was like to work with him. Jamal joined Nvidia in 2022 and worked there until the second half of 2025 as director of product management for AI application software, with an office in the headquarters' Endeavor building, in the same place as Huang's office. On his first day, while crossing the main building, he suddenly saw Huang walk out of the corridor alone, so he went up to say hello; Huang immediately stopped and responded warmly, and the two chatted for 30 to 40 seconds. He had previously worked at Broadcom for four years but had never run into the CEO like that, and Huang's approachability and humility left a strong impression. When Huang was not traveling, Jamal would usually see him in the office corridor every three or four days; it was also easy to tell whether Huang was traveling: if he was not in the office, there were fewer people waiting outside to meet him. Depending on the work, he attended an in-person group meeting with Huang every four to six weeks; he never saw Huang hold one-on-one meetings with employees, as Huang preferred meetings of seven, ten or more people to ensure everyone received exactly the same information at the same time. Nvidia had an unwritten rule: before attending a meeting with Huang, it was best to have sent your "Top 5 Things" (T5T) email. T5T is a simple, direct reporting mechanism: every week or month, each employee emails Huang and his management team listing the five most important things they are working on, current obstacles, and what help they need. Rather than relying on traditional management layers to filter information, Huang reads thousands of T5T emails to understand the company's actual situation directly and in real time; whether you are a junior engineer or a senior director, you have a chance to send your voice and technical views straight to the top. Jamal often saw Huang personally reply to employees' T5T emails; not every email got a reply, of course, but employees sent them and copied him. He recalled a meeting where someone raised a question and Huang paused the meeting to ask: "Did you write about this in your 'Top 5 Things' email?" Everyone present immediately looked down at their laptops. That made him realize T5T was not a formality; Huang wants employees to proactively report their work and problems so that the people who can solve them are involved. Through T5T, the company achieved bottom-up information flow. Preparing for GTC, Nvidia's flagship AI conference, best showed Huang's dedication and love for the area he excels in. They would hold dedicated meetings to decide which demos could be shown at GTC; Huang and the team were近乎 demanding about demo quality, seeking perfection in every detail. He was not satisfied with just looking at slides; he walked the demo area himself, checked every booth and kept asking: "Why is it designed this way? What exactly does this thing do?" Jamal recalled one time Huang stayed at a demo booth for nearly 30 minutes, personally giving the team specific suggestions for improvement and coaching them on how to make the demo better; after the team revised it as suggested, the second showing was noticeably better. No demo could bypass his technical standards; only those meeting his personal standard of technical perfection were allowed on stage. One of the key lessons Jamal took from Huang was to minimize the information gap between management and the front line; Huang could talk directly with engineers and product developers without letting middle managers filter or distort the real situation. Beyond his intense engagement at work, Huang also has a warmth and human touch little known to the outside world, a side rarely seen in news reports. In early 2024, after his daughter was born, Jamal sent Huang a short email sharing the news; he assumed Huang would be too busy to notice, but Huang replied within five minutes to congratulate him. A few days, maybe a week, later, Jamal was in a meeting when Huang's executive assistant suddenly walked in, called his name in front of everyone, and took him to Huang's office; there was a精美的 gift box Huang had prepared especially for Jamal's newborn daughter. He and his wife opened it and found a card from Huang that read: "Shehram, congratulations on your daughter. Best wishes to mother and baby." Jamal believes the card was indeed handwritten by Huang and bore his signature; the box also contained Nvidia-logo clothes and socks for his daughter. items.title_zh: 韩国首次利用紧急灾难通知“0 级短信”打击 AI 辅助作弊行为，成功在高考中抓获 54 名违规考生
items.title_en: South Korea uses "Level 0" emergency disaster alerts for the first time in its college entrance exam to curb AI-assisted cheating, catching 54 violators
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据《韩国先驱报》报道，韩国教育部在 2027 学年度大学修学能力考试（韩国高考）中，首次利用紧急灾难通知“0 级短信”协助打击考试作弊行为，以此成功抓获 54 名违规考生。连同其他检查手段在内，累计有 111 名考生被查出携带违禁设备。 根据韩国媒体报道，考试当天上午 8 时 30 分，也就是正式开考前 10 分钟，第一轮紧急警报响起，共有 31 名考生因携带未经允许的电子设备被查出，相关考生成绩随即被判无效。当天下午 2 时 21 分和 2 时 57 分，第二轮和第三轮警报又分别发现了违规考生，使通过警报系统查出的违规人数达到 54 人。 后续，警方和考务人员又通过金属探测器、Wi-Fi 信号检测以及人工搜查等手段，发现 52 名违规考生，还有 5 人被当场发现正在使用违禁设备， 累计共有 111 名考生被抓 。 与此同时，韩国近期还发生了一起与 AI 辅助作弊争议相关的事件。一名曾在韩国法学院入学考试中取得满分的考生李镇宇（Lee Jin-woo），于高考当天被发现死于一家汽车旅馆。 今年 7 月，李镇宇在韩国法学教育资格考试（LEET）中取得满分，据报道，他是“该考试历史上首位取得这一成绩的考生”。几个月后，他还出版了一本介绍个人学习方法的书籍，分享自己在生活习惯、锻炼、饮食以及减少智能手机使用等方面的调整经验。然而在税务师考试作弊事件曝光后，网络上开始有人质疑李镇宇此前取得的 LEET 满分是否涉及 AI 辅助作弊。 原本，李镇宇计划于韩国高考当天接受采访，以证明自己的学术能力，但他最终没有现身。当天，警方正在调查针对他的法律控告，同时也接到其失踪报告。随后，警方于下午 1 时 12 分在一家汽车旅馆内发现其遗体，初步确认死因为心脏骤停。现场还留有一张字条，内容称其“身心俱疲”，但没有提及作弊指控等相关内容。 目前，韩国针对 AI 辅助考试作弊的讨论仍在持续，此次高考大规模启用紧急灾难通知“0 级短信”，也反映出当地考试机构正在加强对微型摄像头、智能手机及其他电子设备的防范。
items.summary_en: According to The Korea Herald, South Korea's Ministry of Education used the "Level 0" emergency disaster alert for the first time during the 2027 academic-year College Scholastic Ability Test (the country's college entrance exam) to help crack down on exam cheating, catching 54 violators. Together with other screening methods, 111 test-takers in total were found carrying prohibited devices. At 8:30 a.m. on exam day, 10 minutes before the test began, the first emergency alert sounded and 31 test-takers were caught with unauthorized electronic devices, and their scores were immediately invalidated; further alerts at 2:21 p.m. and 2:57 p.m. uncovered more violators, bringing the number detected through the alert system to 54. Police and exam staff later found 52 more violators using metal detectors, Wi-Fi signal detection and manual searches, and 5 people were caught using prohibited devices on the spot, for a total of 111. Separately, a test-taker named Lee Jin-woo, who had scored a perfect result in South Korea's Legal Education Eligibility Test (LEET), was found dead in a motel on the day of the exam. In July he achieved a perfect LEET score and was reported to be "the first test-taker in the exam's history to do so," and months later published a book about his study methods. After a cheating incident in the tax accountant exam came to light, some online users questioned whether his LEET score involved AI-assisted cheating. He had been scheduled to give an interview on exam day to prove his academic ability but did not appear; police were investigating a legal complaint against him and also received a missing-person report, and later found his body in a motel at 1:12 p.m., with cardiac arrest preliminarily identified as the cause of death. A note at the scene said he was "exhausted in body and mind" but did not mention the cheating allegations. Discussion in South Korea about AI-assisted exam cheating continues, and the large-scale use of the "Level 0" alert in this exam also reflects local exam authorities' tightening defenses against miniature cameras, smartphones and other electronic devices.
items.why_zh: 推测：若属实，这是国家级高风险考试首次把公共紧急警报系统用于反作弊，可能影响其他国家对电子设备与AI作弊的监管思路；摘要未提供效果评估，需谨慎看待。
items.why_en: Speculative: if accurate, this would be a rare case of a national high-stakes exam using a public emergency alert system for anti-cheating, potentially influencing how other countries police device- and AI-assisted cheating; the summary provides no assessment of effectiveness, so caution is warranted.

items.title_zh: 谷歌为 Gemini 上线 GIF 动态图片生成功能，由 Omni 1.2 Flash 模型驱动
items.title_en: Google adds GIF generation to Gemini, powered by the Omni 1.2 Flash model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，谷歌宣布为 Gemini 上线 GIF 生成功能，相应功能由视频模型 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 驱动，可生成循环动态图效和搞笑表情包。 该功能面向所有 Google AI 订阅用户开放，并在美国、日本、韩国、澳大利亚、加拿大、英国、德国和法国免费。用户可在主聊天输入提示词，或在图像与视频工具中选择 GIF 并描述需求，等待片刻即可生成图片。 IT之家注意到，谷歌还于 11 月 18 日推出了 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Neon，主攻复杂编程、科学研究和企业工作流程，更好平衡推理能力、任务处理速度与成本，目前已开始向开发者、企业及部分付费订阅用户开放。 费用方面，Gemini 4 Neon 在 API 调用方面，每 100 万词元输入费用为 3 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20 元人民币） ，每 100 万词元输出费用为 15 美元 （现汇率约合 100.2 元人民币） ，缓存输入每百万 token 为 0.15 美元 （现汇率约合 1 元人民币） ，并提供 Low、medium、high 以及 xhigh 四种推理级别。用户订阅 Google AI Pro 或 Ultra 后可以在 Gemini 应用中选择使用该模型。
items.summary_en: Google announced that GIF generation is now available in Gemini, powered by its video model Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, which can produce looping animated effects and humorous meme images. The feature is available to all Google AI subscribers and is free in the US, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Canada, the UK, Germany and France. Users can enter a prompt in the main chat, or select GIF in the image and video tools and describe what they want, then wait briefly for the image to be generated. IT之家 also noted that on November 18 Google launched the AI model Gemini 4 Neon, aimed at complex coding, scientific research and enterprise workflows and seeking a better balance of reasoning capability, task throughput and cost; it is now rolling out to developers, enterprises and some paid subscribers. On pricing, Gemini 4 Neon costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens via API, with cached input at $0.15 per million tokens, and offers four reasoning levels: Low, medium, high and xhigh. Subscribers to Google AI Pro or Ultra can select the model in the Gemini app.
items.why_zh: 推测：把视频生成能力压缩成轻量、易传播的 GIF，并多国免费开放，可能是为了扩大 Google AI 订阅用户在社交内容场景中的日常使用。
items.why_en: Speculative: packaging video generation into lightweight, shareable GIFs and offering it free in several countries may be aimed at driving everyday use of Google AI subscriptions in social content scenarios.

items.title_zh: 华中科技大学与阿里巴巴联合成立 AI 前沿安全研究中心，课题覆盖大模型安全攻防等
items.title_en: HUST and Alibaba launch joint AI frontier security research center with nine initial projects
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，华中科技大学与阿里巴巴集团于 11 月 18 日签署合作协议，聚焦 AI 安全共建“智能攻防与前沿安全联合研究中心”，首批启动 9 个课题。 IT之家获悉，联合研究中心首批启动的 9 个课题，覆盖 大模型安全攻防、智能体与终端安全、智能化系统与软件安全、数据协同与隐私保护 四大方向，以下为官方公开的案例： 当 AI 智能体开始替用户操作手机、完成复杂任务时，屏幕画面可能被伪造，操作过程也可能受到恶意诱导。对此，联合研究中心设立“图像对抗样本与终端威胁研判”课题，探索相关安全风险的识别与防护技术。 当用户在购物、地图、外卖等应用之间切换时，既希望享受数据互通带来的便捷，又担心个人信息在协同过程中泄露。针对这一问题，“隐私保护关系图谱”课题将探索通过密态计算等技术，实现数据“可用不可见、协同不透传”，让便利与隐私保护不再成为单选题。
items.summary_en: Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Alibaba Group signed a cooperation agreement on November 18 to jointly build the “Intelligent Attack-Defense and Frontier Security Joint Research Center” focused on AI security, with nine projects launched in the first batch. The nine projects cover four areas: large-model security attack and defense, agent and endpoint security, security of intelligent systems and software, and data collaboration and privacy protection. Among the publicly disclosed examples: because screen images may be forged and operations may be maliciously induced when AI agents act on a user's phone to complete complex tasks, a project on “image adversarial samples and endpoint threat assessment” will explore identification and protection technologies for such risks; and because users switching among shopping, maps and food-delivery apps want data interoperability without leaking personal information, a “privacy-preserving relationship graph” project will explore technologies such as encrypted computation to achieve data that is “usable but not visible, collaborative but not passed through.”

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，华中科技大学与阿里巴巴集团于 11 月 18 日签署合作协议，聚焦 AI 安全共建“智能攻防与前沿安全联合研究中心”，首批启动 9 个课题。 IT之家获悉，联合研究中心首批启动的 9 个课题，覆盖 大模型安全攻防、智能体与终端安全、智能化系统与软件安全、数据协同与隐私保护 四大方向，以下为官方公开的案例： 当 AI 智能体开始替用户操作手机、完成复杂任务时，屏幕画面可能被伪造，操作过程也可能受到恶意诱导。对此，联合研究中心设立“图像对抗样本与终端威胁研判”课题，探索相关安全风险的识别与防护技术。 当用户在购物、地图、外卖等应用之间切换时，既希望享受数据互通带来的便捷，又担心个人信息在协同过程中泄露。针对这一问题，“隐私保护关系图谱”课题将探索通过密态计算等技术，实现数据“可用不可见、协同不透传”，让便利与隐私保护不再成为单选题。

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，Nothing 发文，预热旗下首款 AI 原生硬件设备将于 12 月 8 日正式亮相。这款产品将采用无屏幕设计，定位为面向日常办公与生产力场景的 AI 工具。 从 此前公布的预热图片 来看，这款设备采用小巧的矩形机身，表面使用拉丝金属材质，并配有实体按键。其中一个面积较大的按键标有“Talk”字样，另一个按键则带有录音标识，机身上还提供红色与绿色 LED 状态指示灯，可以看出该产品预计主打会议记录用途。 Nothing 首席执行官裴宇此前曾表示，当前 AI 技术面临的一大问题是缺乏对用户日常生活的理解。尽管大模型已经具备较强的处理能力，但用户在会议、交谈等场景中产生的信息，往往无法及时成为 AI 能够使用的上下文。因此，Nothing 希望通过专门的硬件设备，让 AI 更自然地融入日常工作。此外，裴宇还透露“相应产品没有屏幕，也不是一款软件应用”。
items.summary_en: Nothing teased that its first AI-native hardware device will be officially unveiled on December 8. The product uses a screenless design and is positioned as an AI tool for everyday office and productivity scenarios. Based on previously released teaser images, the device has a small rectangular body with a brushed metal surface and physical buttons: one larger button is labeled “Talk,” another carries a recording icon, and the body has red and green LED status lights, suggesting the product is likely aimed at meeting-notes use. Nothing CEO Carl Pei previously said a major problem with today's AI is its lack of understanding of users' daily lives; although large models are already capable, information generated in meetings, conversations and similar settings often cannot promptly become context the AI can use, so Nothing hopes dedicated hardware can bring AI more naturally into daily work. He also said the product “has no screen and is not a software app.”
items.why_zh: 推测：无屏幕、带实体按键的专用设备代表“让 AI 获取日常上下文”的另一条硬件路径，与手机和应用内助手路线形成对照。
items.why_en: Speculative: a screenless, button-equipped dedicated device represents an alternative hardware route to giving AI everyday context, contrasting with phone- and app-based assistant approaches.

items.summary_en: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding. The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely shared— and widely misinterpreted , owing to the complexity of the measures it used. METR evaluated models by having them attempt a large suite of tasks, each of which had also been completed by humans. Each task’s difficulty was scored by how long it took the human testers to finish it—and then models were rated according to the length of the tasks that they could complete. That plot showed that AI systems were rapidly improving—every four months, the length of the tasks that frontier models could successfully complete doubled. The updated plot adds more tasks—some that are estimated to take humans far longer than those in the original suite, and others that are more open-ended. One of the biggest questions in AI right now is the extent to which progress on “verifiable” tasks—where it’s possible to check automatically whether an AI system has succeeded or failed—carry over into tasks on which success or failure is harder to measure. We know how to teach neural networks how to do verifiable tasks: Researchers have the systems attempt one many times, strengthen the neural pathways that contribute to success, and weaken the pathways that contribute to failures. items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，全球电子协会（Global Electronics Association）11 月 18 日发布行业警报称，印制电路板（PCB）供应链短缺持续加剧，汽车、工业、医疗、国防和电信企业均反映交期延长、难以保障供应，AI 需求正在挤占本就紧张的产能。 协会指出，这轮需求不仅规模超出供应链原有承载能力，形态也更耗材料。普通 PCB 约为 12 层， AI 服务器用板正转向 40-60 层以上 ，每增加一层都要消耗更多玻纤布、树脂、铜箔和覆铜板。 据协会数据，截至今年 9 月， PCB 订单量同比增长 56.1%，出货量仅增长 13.3% ；高多层板的交期已达 16-20 周甚至更长。协会称，这种需求同时挤压板材制造与上游材料，各个环节的限制相互叠加。 产能扩张并未跟上。协会称，亚洲生产了全球 90% 以上的电路板，东南亚新建 PCB 工厂投入不低于 100 亿美元，中国过去三年的投入也至少相当；但新产线同样依赖玻纤布、树脂、铜箔和覆铜板，仅增加制板产能无法解决短缺。欧洲的全球 PCB 产量份额已从 2000 年的 13.8% 降至 2023 年的 2.2%。 IT之家从报告获悉，协会预计，在需求强劲、复杂度上升、产能增速偏慢的背景下， PCB 短缺至少会持续到 2027 年上半年 ，2028 年中期之前不太可能出现明显缓解。目前超大规模数据中心运营商正在锁定有限供应，汽车、工业、医疗和国防客户的排位则被推到后面。 协会认为， 这一供应链风险可能堪比 2021 年的芯片短缺 ：所有电子系统都依赖 PCB，缺少电路板与材料，半导体和整机组装的投资也无法转化为产出。 协会建议制造商与客户、供应商共享更贴近实际的需求预测，避免重复下单，并为覆铜板、半固化片和铜箔认证替代供应来源。 对政府层面，协会提出建立 PCB 及材料交期预警通道、把半导体激励政策扩展至先进 PCB 与载板制造、加快新产能审批、投资替代材料研发与认证、优先保障国防与医疗等关键订单，并以贷款担保和补贴帮助关键项目与小厂穿越周期。
items.summary_en: The Global Electronics Association issued an industry alert on Nov 18 saying that the PCB supply-chain shortage is worsening; automotive, industrial, medical, defense and telecom companies all report longer lead times and difficulty securing supply, with AI demand crowding out already tight capacity. The association said this demand is not only larger than the supply chain's existing capacity but also more material-intensive. Ordinary PCBs have about 12 layers, while AI server boards are moving to 40-60 layers or more, and each additional layer consumes more glass fabric, resin, copper foil and copper-clad laminate. According to the association, as of September this year PCB orders were up 56.1% year on year while shipments rose only 13.3%; lead times for high-layer boards have reached 16-20 weeks or longer, and demand is squeezing both board manufacturing and upstream materials. Asia produces more than 90% of the world's circuit boards; new PCB plants in Southeast Asia involve at least $10 billion in investment, and China's investment over the past three years is at least comparable, but new lines also depend on glass fabric, resin, copper foil and copper-clad laminate, so adding board-making capacity alone cannot solve the shortage. Europe's share of global PCB output fell from 13.8% in 2000 to 2.2% in 2023. The association expects the PCB shortage to last at least until the first half of 2027, with no significant easing likely before mid-2028; hyperscale data-center operators are locking up limited supply, pushing automotive, industrial, medical and defense customers down the queue. The association believes the supply-chain risk could be comparable to the 2021 chip shortage: all electronic systems depend on PCBs, and without boards and materials, investment in semiconductors and assembly cannot translate into output. It recommends that manufacturers share more realistic demand forecasts with customers and suppliers, avoid double ordering, and qualify alternative sources for copper-clad laminate, prepreg and copper foil; for governments, it proposes an early-warning channel for PCB and material lead times, extending semiconductor incentives to advanced PCB and substrate manufacturing, accelerating approvals for new capacity, investing in alternative material R&D and qualification, prioritizing defense and medical orders, and using loan guarantees and subsidies to help key projects and small firms through the cycle.
